test_title: PYST 60: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined word.

"He was notorious for his __avaricious__ behaviour, always seeking ways to accumulate more wealth."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Greedy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Avaricious"** refers to someone who is extremely greedy or excessively desirous of wealth or material possessions. (लालची)

 
 
• **Example: **The avaricious businessman exploited his employees to maximize his profits.
 
 
 
• **"Greedy"** also conveys the same meaning, referring to someone who has an insatiable desire, especially for wealth or possessions. (लालची)
 
 
• **Example: **The greedy child refused to share his toys with his siblings.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Greedy" is a one-word substitute for "Avaricious."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Greedy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Notorious** (कुख्यात): Famous or well-known for some bad quality or deed.

 
 
• **Example: **The criminal was notorious for his daring bank robberies.
 
 
 
• **Sloth** (आलस्य): Reluctance to work or make an effort; laziness.
 
 
• **Example: **The student's sloth was evident in his incomplete assignments.
 
 
 
• **Generous** (उदार): Willing to give or share more than is usual or expected.
 
 
• **Example: **She is known for her generous donations to charity.
